en: A black-and-white postcard view of a broad river or canal lined with large trees on both sides. On the left bank stands a small wooden house or boathouse near the water's edge, and in the distance a low bridge crosses the water. A stone embankment runs along the right side. The sky is lightly clouded, and in the top-left corner the location name 'Uddevalla.' is printed.
